descriptions.text: The Enchanted Spiked Knee pads the Munificent Goddess Kina. This is a Unique item. This is a Divine Item. These are knee pads. They are literally made of the eyelashes of the sea goddess Kina, who is really just a weird, horny—and when I say horny, I am using both versions of that term—sea-urchin-like, bottom feeder of a goddess who is into some really weird stuff that makes even me blush. This item imbues the following effects: Plus 25% Damage Reflect for melee attacks. The Breathe Underwater benefit. Level 15 Swim skill. Level 10 Iron Stomach skill. Level 10 Eater of the Dead skill. As a divine item, These knee pads will imbue additional, varying benefits when they are in the presence of divine entities.

beats.headline: Made of eyelashes
beats.text: In the interview bubble, Drick calls Katia's knee pads a bit of a waste, since she plans to leave the dungeon one way or another; they were clearly awarded hoping she gives them to Carl, and they even look like his. She does not have them on, Katia says with a panicked look at Carl: she left them in the guild. The AI's voice reads the description. Iron Stomach is new this season: eat a magical item and it is destroyed, and enough of them raise intelligence a point, one to one at level ten, cursed items included. Before she unequipped and gave them away, Katia ate her way to twenty more intelligence. Eater of the Dead is the same with corpses, and raises constitution, strength or dexterity.

beats.headline: Divine, like the patch
beats.text: Kevin asks whether Carl's divine Scavenger's Daughter patch and Katia's knee pads give the same benefits near the same deity. Generally, says Victory, but these are from Kina, so Katia's benefits would be far stronger in Kina's presence, or near certain enemies of Kina. If Katia gave a second divine item to Carl, only the more powerful benefit would apply. There are matched sets of divine armour, Victory adds, and this was prepared far ahead of time.

beats.headline: They fit me
beats.text: Huanxin Jinx has slid to a stop in a circle of words of power, unable to teleport. Do you see my new knee pads, Donut asks. Aren't they lovely? A celestial item she got from Katia, and they fit her. She does not really need this with Huanxin, she admits, but the Eileithyia boon is a five hundred per cent bonus against enemies, and being partied with Carl gives her another five hundred. She starts to stalk in a circle around the heiress.

beats.headline: A goddess in the realm
beats.text: Eris has stopped the world, and Donut hovers in midair, frozen with a yowl. She is wearing her knee pads, which means she has also received a notification that Eris has entered the realm. The last time the goddess came, Donut was unconscious.

beats.headline: On the pig
beats.text: Before Emberus, Carl sets Penelope down out of the line of fire and checks that she still wears the collar with the trap module, and the knee pads: the Enchanted Spiked Kneepads of the Munificent Goddess Kina, gifted to Katia on the ninth floor, given to Donut, and now equipped by Penelope. Among their benefits is breathing underwater. Most importantly, they give the pig the same temporary deity effects as his Scavenger's Daughter patch.
